name: Higher Drops - more ore, stone and weeds
author: Anders
description: Ore rocks, plain stone and grass drop more pieces. Coal 8-34 (was 3-8), Copper 2-3 (was 1), Iron 3-8 (was 1), Gold 2-4, Salt 2-3, Verdite 2-4, Green Crystal 2-5, Void Crystal 2-3, Stone 1-4, Big Rock 15-25 (was 10), Weeds 2-6 from Grass and 8-16 from Big Grass, and the dense versions scale up to match. Magic crystals and gem nodes are unchanged. Edit the DROPS table in js/plugins/HigherDrops.js.
